title: DRS review allowance
summary: 1 unsuccessful review per team, per innings.
explanation: Each side may request a maximum of one unsuccessful review per innings. A review that results in the on-field decision being reversed, in whole or in part, is not counted against that total.
citation: ECB Premier Cricket Playing Conditions 2026, cl. 7.2

title: Over-rate penalty
summary: Sides bowling below the minimum over-rate face a points deduction, not a fine.
explanation: A side that fails to bowl the minimum number of overs in the allotted time, after allowed stoppages, has league points deducted for that fixture rather than a financial penalty.
citation: ECB Premier Cricket Playing Conditions 2026, cl. 9.1

title: Changing the ball
summary: A lost or out-of-shape ball is replaced with one of similar condition, chosen by the umpires, not automatically a new ball.
explanation: Where the ball is lost or becomes unfit for play, the umpires select a replacement of comparable wear from the box provided by the home side. Sides do not have the right to demand a new ball outside the normal new-ball allowance.
citation: ECB Premier Cricket Playing Conditions 2026, cl. 5.4
